protocol.randomDistribution: 33 independent Uniform[0,1) coordinates; same 100 plans scored against each target
protocol.thresholdRule: Per target: max(predeclared floors, 90% of visually accepted reference IoU, precision and boundary F1), rounded down to four decimals. No baseline scores used. Unmatched targets stay uncalibrated.
protocol.score: 100 * min(IoU, boundary F1); precision and serving constraints are separate gates
protocol.passLine: min(IoU/requiredIoU, boundaryF1/requiredF1, precision/requiredPrecision) >= 1; plus all serving checks
protocol.note: Rosetta pass ratios are against predeclared diagnostic floors only; no calibrated pass threshold exists. No baseline-dependent threshold tuning.

task.name: Heart
task.instruction: Pour one centered heart with two rounded lobes, a clear notch, and a tapered point toward the front of the cup.

heart.description: Visually reviewed 32x32 heart: two lobes, central notch, narrowing front. Explicit lobe placement is necessary in this stylized surface model; it is not validated barista physics.

task.name: Tulip
task.instruction: Build three stacked, rounded tulip lobes along the cup's vertical axis, then finish with a narrow central pull-through.

tulip.description: Three explicitly positioned pools match the current fused tulip silhouette. Its binary target already merges the layers; this is not a convincing layered real tulip.

task.name: Rosetta
task.instruction: Create four pairs of leaf-like lobes, mirrored around a thin central stem. The leaves should narrow toward the back of the cup.

rosetta.description: Best hand-designed zigzag candidate from 30 explicit recipes: missing four leaf pairs and the thin stem. Not accepted as a visible target match.

referenceWithoutPull.name: heart reference with final pull removed (extra control)
